meta.name: add-anydoc
meta.description: Add local office-document-to-Markdown conversion to NanoClaw agent containers with the pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI. Use when agents need to read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF files without uploading them to a hosted parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让你的智能助手直接读懂本地各类办公文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的智能助手需要读取本地办公文档却不便上传到云端
copy.tagline_en: Let your AI agent read local office documents directly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI agent to read local office docs without uploading them.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 的容器里会多一个本地转换工具，能把 Word、Excel、PPT 等办公文档转成 Markdown 来读，不上传到托管解析服务。扫描版 PDF 会明确失败，文档里的图片内容可能不完整。
howto.when: 当 agent 需要读取附件里的 Word、Excel、PPT 等办公文档，并且不想把文件上传到托管解析器时触发。

say.text: 把这份 Word 附件转成 Markdown，并总结相关段落
say.note: 在容器内本地转换，不上传

say.text: 把 /workspace 里那份 XLSX 转成 Markdown
say.note: 需给出附件的绝对本地路径

say.text: 这份图片型 PDF 能转吗？
say.note: 会明确报错，且不会上传

howto.what_en: After install, the agent container gains a local converter that turns Word, Excel, PowerPoint and similar office documents into Markdown. Nothing is sent to a hosted parser; scanned PDFs fail clearly and visuals may be incomplete.
howto.when_en: Use when an agent needs to read attached Word, Excel, PowerPoint and similar office documents without uploading them to a hosted parser.

say_en.text: Convert this Word attachment to Markdown and summarize the relevant sections
Convert that XLSX under /workspace to Markdown
say_en.note: Give the file's absolute local path

say_en.text: Can this image-only PDF be converted?
say_en.note: It fails clearly and is not uploaded
